strings.grewPhrases: Tomo grew up → {age}. Now it speaks in two-word phrases.
strings.grewTalking: Tomo grew up → {age}. Now it talks with you: pick what it means, or a reply that fits!
strings.answerOwnWords: Answer in your own words: type or tap the mic · {ai}
strings.notNow: Not now: Tomo waits beside the notch
strings.mic.permission: Allow Microphone and Speech Recognition for Tomodachi in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
strings.mic.unavailable: {language} speech recognition isn't available on this Mac.
strings.mic.notInstalled: On-device {language} recognition isn't installed. Add {language} in System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation, or type your answer.
strings.outcome.why.loss: Tomo didn't get it. Try again!
strings.outcome.why.language: Not in {language}: no score, no penalty
strings.outcome.why.help: You asked for help: no score, no penalty
strings.settings.learningNote: Each language you learn has its own Tomo. Progress is saved on this Mac and synced to your other devices through iCloud.
strings.settings.openAtLogin: Open Tomodachi when you log in
strings.settings.openAtLoginNote: Tomo can only drop in while Tomodachi is open.
strings.settings.openAtLoginApprove: Allow Tomodachi in System Settings → General → Login Items.
strings.settings.restartNote: A new Tomo at level 1. You'll be asked first.
strings.about.tagline: A little friend in your notch who only speaks the language you're learning, at its own age.
strings.about.feedback: Tell us what felt fun, confusing, or annoying.
strings.about.credits: Tomodachi by Zenbu Japanese. Notch shell based on Coucou by Louis Raillé (MIT License). Tomo's shapes and seeded looks adapted from blobatar by Alain (MIT License). Word ages from Wordbank (CC BY 4.0; Frank et al. 2017). Japanese data: Tsuji, Hagihara and Minagawa (Japanese CDI, Ogura & Watamaki). English data: MacArthur-Bates CDI norming samples (Fenson, Marchman et al.). Ages 3–6 in Japanese: NINJAL 幼児語彙 and 絵本語彙 (CC BY 4.0). Some English meanings: JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0).
strings.ai.footer: Without a provider, Tomo uses built-in offline replies. The key is stored in your Keychain.
strings.explain.askPlaceholder: Which part? e.g. like to do
strings.explain.noAI: Add an AI provider in Settings → AI for step-by-step explanations.
strings.word.title: Word
strings.levelUp: Level {level}! New words for Tomo to learn.
strings.outcome.why.practice: Practice: it's too soon after the last time to count. Come back later and it counts again.
strings.startOver.title: Start Tomo over?
strings.startOver.body: Your {language} Tomo goes back to level 1, and the words it learned from you are cleared. This can't be undone.
strings.settings.testingNote: Testing runs on a copy of Tomo in memory: trying another age or skipping ahead never changes your saved Tomo. Back to my Tomo ends it.
strings.words.lastLevel: {known} of {needed} words known · the last level for now
strings.words.testing: This is a testing Tomo. Settings → Back to my Tomo.
strings.growth.age.1: A tiny blob, just hatched. Single baby words: tap the picture, or feed, put to bed and hug Tomo.
strings.growth.age.2: Evolves into a new shape. Two-word phrases.
strings.growth.age.3: Evolves again, a little bigger. Talks with you: pick what Tomo means, or a reply that fits.
strings.growth.age.4: Preschool words from everyday talk and picture books.
strings.growth.age.5: More preschool words: feelings, places, how things happen.
strings.growth.age.6: Words children know before starting school.
strings.grewOlder: Tomo grew up → {age}. New words to learn!
strings.practice.offer: Nothing counts until {time}. You can practice, but it won't move the bar.
strings.practice.offer.now: Nothing counts right now. You can practice, but it won't move the bar.
strings.dizzy: Too many pokes. Tomo is dizzy; back in three seconds.
strings.glance.new: A new word is ready to learn
strings.glance.about: Tomo, and whether anything is waiting.
